column1: Table 4 Initial chemical composition of senescent needles. All values in mg g$^-1$ (mean ± SE, *n* = 3) Significant differences between sites were only found for lignin and N (ANOVA, *p* < 0.05). For within-site comparisons, significant differences were only found for K in Garde (P0 > P30, *p* = 0.043, linear contrast). The latter result was probably due to differences among thinning intensities in throughfall reaching senescent litter, before litter collection.
